adapter.method: Read production source as data; insert no-RNG latent collectors in memory; import data URL with absolute palm-frame import; verify all six B0 mesh attributes/index bytes before experiment

definition.health: exclude 9 young and 14 dead fronds; change 175 healthy mature fronds only
definition.bareEndpoint: fixed earliest original pinna root; never recompute from a candidate
definition.arcCoordinate: s = original analytic rachis arclength from original model root; theta=A*smoothstep((s-(bare+(total-bare)/2))/((total-bare)/2))
definition.signedTorsion: positive right-hand angle about original local rachis tangent, same sign on both pinna ranks; not camera-dependent
definition.natural: rotate initial F, original curl and ridge vectors by Q; leave -worldY*droop*s_leaf² unchanged; rotate original B0 edge offsets by Q
definition.constrained: separate geometric experiment, not a physics solve: normalize each natural target midrib segment and use its original uploaded B0 segment length; root fixed; do not rotate gravity into a local axis; each B0 section receives SO(3) Q plus minimal tangent alignment. Sag magnitude is allowed to respond to the geometric constraint; no claim of elastic equilibrium or exact original pointwise sag.
definition.significanceThreshold: any active pinna actual uploaded midrib polyline arc changes by more than 1%; test constrained independently if so
definition.zero: return B0 buffer object, not regenerated trigonometry

conservationAssessment.meaning: A valid finite mesh is not the same as a shape-only / inextensible experiment; natural candidates fail this separate gate, despite near-zero whole-crown mean.

representativeFrond.selection: median original whole-rachis arclength among 175 healthy fronds; chosen before comparing candidate projections

limits: No GPU, rasterized coverage, occlusion, shadows, optical response, dynamic motion or timing measurement
Projected triangle area is unoccluded geometry only; not screen pixel coverage or a quality score
Reported arclength is actual uploaded discrete midrib polyline, not an unrepresented anatomical smooth curve
All nominal length/width controls and leaf count stay fixed; this alone does not imply arc or surface-area conservation
Segment constraint preserves discrete lengths, not triangle surface area, physical beam equilibrium or exact pointwise sag
Both candidates need aLeafAxis, TBN, bounds, shadow, GI and history updates; 0 reuses exact B0
0/45/75 are experiments, not a universal botanical torsion prescription
